podcast.title: Canadian Two-Piece Band
podcast.body: Japandroids is listed as a Canadian two-piece band that emerged in the early 2000s, contributing to the growing phenomenon of rock duos. "A lot of this new generation were Canadian. Black pistol fire, death from above 1979. Japan droids, the PAKAD, USS Duortang, the Blue Stones."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 6: (50-41)

podcast.title: Grinding Sound Approach to Punk Revival
podcast.body: Japandroids was cited as an example of a band with a "grinding sound" approach within the mid-decade punk revival of the 2010s. This revival encompassed a wide variety of styles, including Garage Punk and Post Punk, and demonstrated how punk had evolved beyond just a sound to an attitude and a way of life. "There was a wide variety of approaches from Laura Jane Grace and against me to the riot girl sensibilities of the reformed Slater Kinney, to the grinding sound of Japan droids, to the intensity of F-Dup and the stoner feel of Park Ae Courts and the working-class rage of idols and sleafed mods."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 4: The Revivals
